query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

parts.text:
*(You stand atop the capstan, one hand resting on the hilt of your cutlass, the ocean wind whipping your coat around you. You look down at the grimy, tired faces of your crew, waiting for your word.)*

"Bring ’er in, ye scoundrels, and listen close! 

Look at ye. Smelling of sour grog, damp bilge, and stale hardtack. Is this the life ye envisioned when ye took the black? To die broke, forgotten, and sober in some godforsaken, muddy ditch? To let the royal navy hunt us like dogs while we scramble for table scraps? 

*No!* We didn't hoist the Jolly Roger to live like beggars. We took to the waves for one thing, and one thing only: **Glory, and more gold than we can carry!**

Right now, just beyond that storm-tossed horizon, lies the island of Isla de la Muerte. Deep beneath its black sands, buried in the dark where the sun fears to shine, sits a fortune that would make the King of Spain himself weep like a babe. Chests bursting with Spanish doubloons, emeralds as large as a fist, and chalices of solid gold. It’s been rotting in the dirt for a hundred years, just waiting for a crew brave enough—and mad enough—to go and claim it.

Aye, I’ve heard the whispers. 'The waters are treacherous,' ye say. 'The reef is a graveyard,' ye mutter. 'The treasure is cursed!' 

I say *damn the curse*, and damn the reefs! Since when does the crew of the *Crimson Dread* fear a few dusty bones or a bit of rough water? We *are* the curse of the seven seas! The sea doesn't own us, we own *it*! 

We find this chest, and I promise ye this: every man jack of ye will be drinking the finest rum from silver cups for the rest of your days. You’ll be wearing silk shirts, buying your own taverns, and looking down on the very lords who wanted us hanged! You won't just be sailors anymore—you'll be *kings*.

So, what say ye, ye scurvy dogs? Will ye stay here, shivering in the bilge, or will ye ride the wind with me and carve our names into history? 

Unfurl the sails! Ready the spades! To the wind, to the waves, and to the gold! *Huzzah!*"
